lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Morning nets spread on the black sand, the monsoon wind hums low
Thirty monsoons have etched their lines on the hull I know

[Chorus]
The sea sighs, the sea sighs
It takes, it gives, it never lies

[Verse 2]
Children’s laughter fades where the casuarina once stood
Now plastic bottles kiss the shore where the tide once could

[Chorus]
The sea sighs, the sea sighs
It takes, it gives, it never lies

brief.theme: a fisherman in Kerala watching the sea change over thirty years
